subject: URGENT: cold-chain incident — diversion recommendation for Apex pallets
messages:
From: ColdTransit Ops <ops@coldtransit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: 4 pallets (Apex) temp excursion — recommended diversion

Hi Marcus,

We had a temperature excursion on the inbound trailer for the 4 pallets bound for the Apex booth (PO #APX-778). The ThermoTrack recorder indicates a spike to ~12°C for approximately 90 minutes during the last leg. Apex product spec calls for <=4°C.

Carrier ops recommend immediate diversion to the nearest bonded cold storage rather than attempting delivery to the venue; attempting to re-ice and continue risks product degradation and potential rejection by the venue health team.

Options for your decision:
- Divert to ColdTransit Warehouse A (San Francisco) — closest, approx 2 hours. Quarantine until Apex confirms disposition.
- Try re-icing on-site and proceed to the Crystal Center (risk: possible rejection).

If you choose diversion, we can reconsign to bonded cold storage and provide a cold storage booking and photos. There will be a diversion fee and cold storage daily charge; estimate attached in the booking stub.

Attachments: temp_log_778.csv (CSV), trailer_manifest_APX778.pdf (PDF)

Please confirm ASAP so we can avoid further transit time.

Thanks,
Luis Ortega
ColdTransit Logistics — Ops
ops@coldtransit.com | (415) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ColdTransit Ops <ops@coldtransit.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: 4 pallets (Apex) temp excursion — recommended diversion

Luis — thanks for the heads up and for the clear options. Divert to ColdTransit Warehouse A and quarantine. Do not attempt delivery to the venue.

Action items for ColdTransit:
- Reconsign to bonded cold storage and send booking confirmation + invoice estimate (we will route to event budget).
- Take continuous photos of pallets and the thermo recorder readout; include manifest and chain-of-custody note.
- Hold for disposition instructions from the Apex contact (cc'd below).

Tessa / Vanessa: please note this against the SF show logistics case and authorize diversion. Vanessa — please coordinate any customs/broker notes if the crate also touched cross-border paperwork.

Marcus Lin
